<!-- Template Documentation -->
== Usage ==
To add this userbox to your user page, insert:

<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{User:Powercycler/Userbox RefDiff}}
</syntaxhighlight>

=== Live Preview ===
{{Userbox
| border-c = #d4a017
| border-s = 1
| id-s     = 8
| id       = <span style="font-family: monospace, Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: bold; color: #c98a0c; background: rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.18); border: 1px solid rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.45); padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block;">⟨~ref~⟩</span>
| info-s   = 8
| info-lh  = 1.25em
| info     = This user reviews diffs and combats [[User:Powercycler/RefDiff#The Problem: Template Camouflage|template camouflage]] with '''[[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]]'''.
}}

== Customization Options ==

You can customize the badge symbol, border colors, and text:

{| class="wikitable"
! Wikitext !! Rendered Userbox !! Description
|-
| {{mono|<nowiki>{{User:Powercycler/Userbox RefDiff}}</nowiki>}}
| {{Userbox
| border-c = #d4a017
| id       = <span style="font-family: monospace, Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: bold; color: #c98a0c; background: rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.18); border: 1px solid rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.45); padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block;">⟨~ref~⟩</span>
| info     = This user reviews diffs and combats [[User:Powercycler/RefDiff#The Problem: Template Camouflage|template camouflage]] with '''[[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]]'''.
}}
| '''Default:''' Signature amber modified badge ({{mono|⟨~ref~⟩}}) representing citation decoupling in diffs.
|-
| {{mono|<nowiki>{{User:Powercycler/Userbox RefDiff|badge=⟨ref⟩|border-c=#3366cc}}</nowiki>}}
| {{Userbox
| border-c = #3366cc
| id       = <span style="font-family: monospace, Courier, monospace; font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: bold; color: #3366cc; background: rgba(51, 102, 204, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(51, 102, 204, 0.4); padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px; display: inline-block;">⟨ref⟩</span>
| info     = This user reviews diffs and combats [[User:Powercycler/RefDiff#The Problem: Template Camouflage|template camouflage]] with '''[[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]]'''.
}}
| '''Minimalist Prose Badge:''' Neutral blue angle bracket badge.
|-
| {{mono|<nowiki>{{User:Powercycler/Userbox RefDiff|badge=⧉ RefDiff|border-c=#3366cc}}</nowiki>}}
| {{Userbox
| border-c = #3366cc
| id       = <span style="font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: bold; color: #3366cc;">⧉ RefDiff</span>
| info     = This user reviews diffs and combats [[User:Powercycler/RefDiff#The Problem: Template Camouflage|template camouflage]] with '''[[User:Powercycler/RefDiff|RefDiff]]'''.
}}
| '''Toolbar Mode Icon:''' Matches the OOUI diff toolbar mode button.
|}

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Default !! Description
|-
| {{mono|badge}} (or {{mono|1}}) || {{mono|⟨~ref~⟩}} || Badge symbol or icon displayed in the left box.
|-
| {{mono|border-c}} || {{mono|#d4a017}} || Border color of the userbox.
|-
| {{mono|border-s}} || {{mono|1}} || Border thickness in pixels.
|-
| {{mono|id-c}} || (theme default) || Optional custom background color of the left badge/icon box (omit for automatic dark mode support).
|-
| {{mono|id-fc}} || (theme default) || Optional custom font color of the left badge/icon box.
|-
| {{mono|id-s}} || {{mono|8}} || Font size of the left badge/icon box (in points).
|-
| {{mono|info-c}} || (theme default) || Optional custom background color of the right text box (omit for automatic dark mode support).
|-
| {{mono|info-fc}} || (theme default) || Optional custom font color of the right text box.
|-
| {{mono|info-s}} || {{mono|8}} || Font size of the right text box (in points).
|-
| {{mono|info-lh}} || {{mono|1.25em}} || Line height of the right text box.
|-
| {{mono|info}} || (see default) || Custom informational text.
|-
| {{mono|link}} || {{mono|User:Powercycler/RefDiff}} || Wiki page link for RefDiff (use {{mono|m:User:Powercycler/RefDiff}} for global/Meta-Wiki links).
|}

== Pure HTML Fallback ==
For wikis where the {{tlx|Userbox}} template is not installed, use this standalone HTML snippet:

<syntaxhighlight lang="html">
<div class="wikipediauserbox" style="float: left; border: 1px solid #d4a017; margin: 1px; width: 238px;">
<table role="presentation" style="width: 238px; text-align: left; border-collapse: collapse;">
<tr>
  <td style="width: 45px; height: 45px; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; font-size: 8pt;">
    <span style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.75em; font-weight: bold; color: #c98a0c; background: rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.18); border: 1px solid rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.45); padding: 1px 2px; border-radius: 3px;">⟨~ref~⟩</span>
  </td>
  <td style="font-size: 8pt; padding: 4pt; line-height: 1.25em; vertical-align: middle;">
    This user reviews diffs and combats <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Powercycler/RefDiff#The_Problem:_Template_Camouflage">template camouflage</a> with <b><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User:Powercycler/RefDiff">RefDiff</a></b>.
  </td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</syntaxhighlight>
